faq.q: What is the main song in GTA 6 Trailer 2?
faq.a: The Pointer Sisters' 1986 song "Hot Together" soundtracks the bulk of Grand Theft Auto VI's second trailer, released May 6, 2026. It underscores a montage introducing Jason Duvall and Lucia Camino.

faq.q: What album is Hot Together from?
faq.a: The 1986 album of the same name, Hot Together, by the Pointer Sisters. NME identified the track by ear and confirmed its timing in the trailer at around the 1:04 mark.

faq.q: Has Hot Together been used in anything else before GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes. The song had previously appeared in the 1987 film Spaceballs and in the film Stakeout, according to the record covering its GTA VI Trailer 2 use.

faq.q: What scenes does Hot Together play over in GTA 6 Trailer 2?
faq.a: It covers scenes of romance, gunfights, and a helicopter chase through the fictional state of Leonida, introducing dual protagonists Jason Duvall and Lucia Camino.

faq.q: Is Hot Together officially confirmed as the GTA 6 Trailer 2 song?
faq.a: Music outlet NME identified the track by ear and confirmed its timing within the trailer, rather than Rockstar publishing a credit list. Whether Rockstar has separately confirmed it elsewhere is not stated in this record.
